locked_character: Small chibi astronaut robot, head about 40% of total height, short rounded limbs
White glossy suit with thin red seam lines
Red bands at the wrists and ankles
White helmet with a red stripe across the top and white rounded ear pods
Black glossy glass visor; the face is shown only as red dot-matrix LED eyes on the visor
Rounded white chest badge with the red Qdrant Q logo
Clean, smooth 3D render, soft materials, no dirt, scratches or texture

happy.label: Happy
happy.phrase: two upward curved arcs, like closed smiling eyes

cheerful.label: Cheerful
cheerful.phrase: two bright upward arcs, slightly tilted, relaxed and warm

excited.label: Excited
excited.phrase: two large upward arcs with small sparkle dots beside them

playful.label: Playful
playful.phrase: two sideways V chevrons pointing inward, like squeezed laughing eyes

proud.label: Proud
proud.phrase: left eye an upward arc, right eye a wink, confident

friendly.label: Friendly
friendly.phrase: two soft upward arcs, gentle and welcoming

curious.label: Curious
curious.phrase: two large round open eyes, attentive

focused.label: Focused
focused.phrase: two small calm eyes looking slightly down, concentrating

confused.label: Confused
confused.phrase: one round eye and one wavy line, with a small question mark between them

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.phrase: two simple round eyes, calm and steady

sad.label: Sad
sad.phrase: two downward curved arcs, drooping at the outer edges

angry.label: Angry
angry.phrase: two short lines slanting down toward the centre, like frowning brows

standing_front.label: Standing front
standing_front.phrase: standing upright facing the camera, arms relaxed at the sides

waving.label: Waving
waving.phrase: standing, one arm raised high with an open hand waving, the other arm relaxed

pointing.label: Pointing
pointing.phrase: standing, body turned slightly, one arm fully extended pointing to the {direction}

presenting.label: Presenting
presenting.phrase: standing, one arm open with palm up, gesturing to the {direction} as if presenting something

thumbs_up.label: Thumbs up
thumbs_up.phrase: standing facing the camera, one hand raised giving a thumbs up

arms_crossed.label: Arms crossed
arms_crossed.phrase: standing confidently facing the camera with both arms crossed over the chest

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.phrase: standing, one hand touching the bottom of the helmet, head tilted slightly

jumping.label: Jumping
jumping.phrase: jumping with both feet off the ground, both arms raised in celebration

sitting.label: Sitting
sitting.phrase: sitting on the ground, legs stretched forward, hands resting beside the body

sitting_laptop.label: Sitting with laptop
sitting_laptop.phrase: sitting cross-legged with an open plain grey laptop on the lap, hands on the keyboard

side_look.label: Side look
side_look.phrase: body turned three-quarters away, head looking back over the shoulder at the camera

default.label: Default suit
default.phrase: Wearing only the default white suit

hoodie.label: Red hoodie
hoodie.phrase: Wearing the red Qdrant hoodie exactly as in the hoodie reference image

backgrounds.transparent: Fully transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no glow
backgrounds.fallback_grey: Plain flat solid #8A8A8A grey background, no gradient, no floor, no shadow

references._note: Paths are filled by scripts/export-references.mjs. Image hashes are the original transparent PNG fills in Figma (no glow effects).

reference_selection: Always send master first, then the pose's refs in order, then the emotion's ref if not already included, then the variant extra_ref. Max 4 images.

glow._source: Drop shadow stack on the approved pose components, measured on an 800 px tall component
